Flashes, hunting machine eyes and the extraction beacon now light the ground in their own colour at night; that's shipped as v34.80 and passed the full gate. I took no pictures and no 4K frame numbers yet.

- **What changed:** flashes use the colour they already store, hunting machine eyes use the eye-glow red, and the beacon uses teal. Your lamp and the teammate lamp stay white. Reduced flashing is untouched.
- **Frame cost:** I expect no new cost, because the draw count is the same and the sprite is cached per colour. That is reasoning, not a measurement.
- **Why it stopped twice before:** my check set the raid to night and never reset it. The seed 4242 fingerprint run after it then spawned 112/482 entities instead of 85/374. I proved this with a comment-only ship, v34.79, which held the fingerprint. The check now restores the setting. Preflight doesn't run the fingerprint, so it passed anyway.
- **Gate:** the new check passes on the new build and the fingerprint holds at 85/374 and 165/593.
- **What to watch next time you play at night:** a blast, cryo or acid should tint the street in its own colour. Hunting machines should throw red light and the beacon teal.

I added no DESIGN.md frame line, and the notes are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/124-gfx-coloured-flash-light.md`. The gate Chrome on port 9346 was down once during this run, so I restarted it.
